args.question: Could you provide the estimated or claimed dollar amount for the fire damage (to the vehicle, garage shelving, and drywall), along with a breakdown of the affected items/repairs? The claim currently has no claimed amount or itemized costs listed.
args.reasoning: The claim has no claimed_amount_stated and no line_items at all, so there is no dollar value to evaluate, route by threshold, or verify arithmetically. This is distinct from receipts=false (which is expected pre-repair) — here we lack even an estimated total or itemization of what is being claimed (vehicle damage vs. garage structure damage). This is information the claimant (or their contractor/adjuster estimate) can readily supply, so a clarifying question is appropriate rather than escalation or approval. Other fields (dates, description, document flags) are internally consistent and not contradictory, so this isn't an escalation-worthy inconsistency at this stage.
